mxCell.value: PortFlow Enterprise Dual REST & GraphQL System Architecture
Client Tier: React 19 Single Page Application (SPA)
Terminal Operator & Admin UI (Vite + React 19 + Tailwind CSS)
Operations & Vessel Hub (Real-time PCB State Monitor)
OS Simulator Visualizer (Gantt Chart, WFG Deadlock Graph)
Analytics & Reports UI (Relational Telemetry & Logs)
Dual API Client (REST Client + Apollo GraphQL Client)
API Gateway Tier: Express 5 Dual-Protocol Engine
Security Middleware Helmet, CORS, Rate Limiters, JWT Bearer Authentication
REST API Router (/api/*) • /auth (Login, Register, 30s OTP) • /operations (CRUD & Dispatch) • /ships, /cargos, /equipments • /system (Logs, Reports, Issues) • /trash (Soft-Delete Reclaim)

GraphQL Apollo Server (/graphql) • Schema SDL & Resolvers • Query: portDashboardOverview, ships, cargo • Nested Graph Traversals (Zero N+1) • Mutation: createOperation, reportIssue • JWT Auth Context Injection
Core Processing Tier: OS Simulator Kernel & Service Layer
Operating System Kernel (In-Memory Simulation)
CPU Scheduler • FCFS Algorithm • SJF (Shortest Job First) • Priority Scheduling • Ready Queue Management
Resource Allocators • Mutex Locks (Quay Cranes) • Counting Semaphores (Berths) • Promise-based Wait Queues
Deadlock Detector • Wait-For Graph (WFG) • Cycle Detection via DFS • Resource Allocation Matrix
Business Services & Repositories
Prisma ORM Client Layer • Type-safe Queries • 2-Phase Soft-Delete Logic • Connection Pooling • Transaction Management
Database Tier: PostgreSQL 15 Relational Database (3NF Supabase Engine)
Core Fleet & Operations • users (Auth & RBAC) • ships (IMO & TEU) • equipment (Berths/Cranes) • operations (PCB Logs) • cargo (Containers)
Land Logistics & Yard • warehouses (CFS & Reefer) • trucks (Drayage Fleet) • gate_passes (Perimeter Gate)
Customs, Tariff & Support • customs_inspections (Holds) • bills (Tariff Invoicing) • issues (Hardware Incident Tickets)
Audit & Observability • system_logs (Runtime Trail) • PL/pgSQL Triggers (updated_at) • Performance B-Tree Indexes • Row Level Security (RLS)
HTTP REST / JSON (JWT)
GraphQL Query / Mutation
Dispatch & Algorithm Control
CRUD & Graph Resolution
SQL Transactions & Telemetry
PortFlow OS Kernel & Service Layer - Object-Oriented Class Diagram

Process (PCB) --------------------------------------- + id: string + burstTime: number + remainingTime: number + priority: number + status: ProcessStatus + requiredResources: string[] + startTime: number | null + completionTime: number | null + waitingTime: number + turnaroundTime: number --------------------------------------- + updateStatus(newStatus: ProcessStatus): void + executeSlice(time: number): boolean + calculateTelemetry(currentTime: number): void

Scheduler --------------------------------------- - algorithm: 'FCFS' | 'SJF' | 'Priority' - readyQueue: Process[] - executedProcesses: Process[] --------------------------------------- + setAlgorithm(algo: string): void + addProcess(proc: Process): void + removeProcess(id: string): boolean + getNextProcess(): Process | null + getQueue(): Process[] + calculateAverages(): MetricsDTO

Mutex (Quay Crane Lock) --------------------------------------- - name: string - locked: boolean - ownerProcessId: string | null - waitQueue: string[] --------------------------------------- + acquire(processId: string): Promise<boolean> + release(processId: string): boolean + isLocked(): boolean + getOwner(): string | null + getWaiting(): string[]

Semaphore (Berth Pool) --------------------------------------- - name: string - capacity: number - availablePermits: number - waitQueue: string[] --------------------------------------- + acquire(processId: string): Promise<boolean> + release(processId: string): boolean + getAvailable(): number + getCapacity(): number + getWaiting(): string[]

DeadlockDetector (WFG) --------------------------------------- - adjacencyList: Map<string, string[]> - deadlockCycles: string[][] --------------------------------------- + buildGraph(allocations, requests): void + detectCycleDFS(): boolean + getDeadlockedProcesses(): string[] + resetGraph(): void

<<Singleton>> PortSystem ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- - static instance: PortSystem - scheduler: Scheduler - cranes: Map<string, Mutex> - berths: Map<string, Semaphore> - deadlockDetector: DeadlockDetector ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- + static getInstance(): PortSystem + registerCrane(name: string): void + registerBerths(name: string, capacity: number): void + addProcess(proc: Process): void + executeNextProcess(): Promise<Process | null> + getSystemState(): OSStateDTO

OperationsService --------------------------------------- - repo: IOperationsRepository - portSystem: PortSystem --------------------------------------- + getOperations(filter): Promise<OperationRecord[]> + getOperationById(id): Promise<OperationRecord> + submitOperation(dto): Promise<OperationRecord> + updateOperation(id, dto): Promise<OperationRecord> + deleteOperation(id, by): Promise<OperationRecord> + dispatchNext(): Promise<DispatchResult> + getMetrics(): Promise<OperationMetricsDTO>

OperationsRepository --------------------------------------- - prisma: PrismaClient --------------------------------------- + findActive(): Promise<OperationRecord[]> + findById(id): Promise<OperationRecord | null> + findByProcessId(pid): Promise<OperationRecord> + create(data): Promise<OperationRecord> + update(id, data): Promise<OperationRecord> + softDelete(id, by): Promise<OperationRecord>

GraphQL Resolvers Module --------------------------------------- + Query.portDashboardOverview() + Query.ships(status) + Query.cargo(status, shipId) + Query.operations(status, priority) + Mutation.createOperation(args) + Mutation.reportIssue(args) + Mutation.dispatchOperation() + Ship.assignedBerth() / cargoManifests() + Operation.vessel() / container() / assignedCrane()
PortFlow Enterprise Phase 3 Relational Database Schema (3NF)

users --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * email: VARCHAR(255) [UK] * password_hash: VARCHAR(255) * full_name: VARCHAR(120) * role: VARCHAR(50) * created_at: TIMESTAMPTZ deleted_at: TIMESTAMPTZ deleted_by: VARCHAR(255)

equipment --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * equipment_id: VARCHAR(50) [UK] * name: VARCHAR(120) * type: VARCHAR(50) * status: VARCHAR(50) capacity_metric: FLOAT assigned_to: VARCHAR(100) deleted_at: TIMESTAMPTZ

ships --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * imo_number: VARCHAR(100) [UK] * name: VARCHAR(120) * vessel_type: VARCHAR(100) * capacity_teu: INT * status: VARCHAR(50) # berth_equipment_id: INT [FK] deleted_at: TIMESTAMPTZ

warehouses --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * code: VARCHAR(50) [UK] * name: VARCHAR(120) * zone_type: VARCHAR(50) * capacity_teu: INT * current_occupancy_teu: INT temperature_celsius: FLOAT status: VARCHAR(50)

cargo --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * cargo_number: VARCHAR(100) [UK] * size_type: VARCHAR(50) * weight_tons: FLOAT * cargo_type: VARCHAR(100) * status: VARCHAR(50) # ship_id: INT [FK] # warehouse_id: INT [FK] deleted_at: TIMESTAMPTZ

operations (OS Processes) --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * process_id: VARCHAR(50) [UK] * operation_type: VARCHAR(100) * priority: INT * status: VARCHAR(50) # ship_id: INT [FK] # cargo_id: INT [FK] # crane_equipment_id: INT [FK] # berth_equipment_id: INT [FK] # created_by_user_id: INT [FK] waiting_time_ms: INT turnaround_time_ms: INT

trucks --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * license_plate: VARCHAR(50) [UK] * driver_name: VARCHAR(120) * driver_phone: VARCHAR(50) * transport_company: VARCHAR(150) * status: VARCHAR(50) # assigned_cargo_id: INT [FK]

gate_passes --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * pass_number: VARCHAR(100) [UK] # truck_id: INT [FK - Cascade] # cargo_id: INT [FK] # issued_by_id: INT [FK] * gate_lane: VARCHAR(50) * status: VARCHAR(50) check_in_time: TIMESTAMPTZ

customs_inspections --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * inspection_number: VARCHAR(100) [UK] # cargo_id: INT [FK - Cascade] # inspector_id: INT [FK] * declaration_number: VARCHAR(100) * status: VARCHAR(50) * duty_amount_cents: BIGINT findings: TEXT

bills (Tariff Invoices) --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * invoice_number: VARCHAR(100) [UK] # ship_id: INT [FK] # cargo_id: INT [FK] # operation_id: INT [FK] * customer_name: VARCHAR(150) * total_amount: DOUBLE * payment_status: VARCHAR(50)

issues (Incident Reports) --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] * ticket_number: VARCHAR(50) [UK] # reported_by_id: INT [FK] # equipment_id: INT [FK] * title: VARCHAR(200) * severity: VARCHAR(50) * status: VARCHAR(50) resolved_at: TIMESTAMPTZ
system_logs --------------------------------- + id: SERIAL [PK] # user_id: INT [FK] * timestamp: TIMESTAMPTZ * level: VARCHAR(20) * source: VARCHAR(100) * message: TEXT action: VARCHAR(100)

PortFlow OS Process Dispatch & Concurrency Control Flowchart
Start: Operator Submits Job (Discharge / Load Cargo)
Validate Input & JWT (Check Ship, Crane & Berth)
Persist to PostgreSQL status = 'Queued', priority = N
Initialize Process Control Block (PCB) Add to OS Ready Queue
CPU Scheduler Selects Next (Active Policy: FCFS / SJF / Priority)
Is Assigned Crane Mutex Available?
Process enters WAITING State Enqueued in Crane Mutex WaitQueue
Deadlock Detector (WFG) Run DFS Cycle Detection
Deadlock Alert: Circular Wait Found! Log Warning to System Logs
Acquire Crane Mutex Lock & Acquire Berth Semaphore Permit
Process enters RUNNING State Update start_time in PostgreSQL Simulate Burst Execution (3-5s)
Execution Complete! Release Crane Mutex & Berth Semaphore Notify Next Process in WaitQueue
Calculate Wt and Tt Telemetry Update status = 'Completed' Auto-Generate Tariff Billing Record
End: Real-time UI Updated (Live WebSockets / Query Refresh)
No (Locked)
Cycle Detected
Yes (Free)
PortFlow End-to-End Sequence Diagram (Operation Creation & OS Dispatch)
Operator (UI) [React 19]
API Gateway [Express 5 / REST / GQL]
OperationsService [Business Logic]
PortSystem [OS Kernel / Mutex]
Prisma ORM [Data Client]
PostgreSQL 15 [Supabase DB]
1: POST /api/operations (shipName, craneId, priority)
2: submitOperation(dto)
3: prisma.operation.create(data: status='Queued')
4: INSERT INTO operations (process_id, priority, ...)
5: Record committed (ID=101, process_id='op-101')
6: addProcess(new Process('op-101', burstTime, reqCrane))
7: HTTP 201 Created (Operation OP-101 Queued)
8: POST /api/operations/dispatch (Trigger CPU Scheduler)
9: executeNextProcess() [FCFS/SJF selection]
10: craneMutex.acquire('op-101') & berthSemaphore.acquire()
11: Process RUNNING -> Burst Complete -> Release Mutex
12: UPDATE operations SET status='Completed', turnaround_time_ms=...
13: INSERT INTO bills (invoice_number, docking_fee, crane_usage_fee)
14: HTTP 200 OK (dispatched: 101, waitingTime: 120ms, turnaround: 4120ms)
15: POST /graphql { query: portDashboardOverview { ... } }
16: JSON Response { data: { tableStats, activeOperationsCount } }
